title: Modular forms and the generalized residue theorem
abstract: Formalizes the Hungerbühler-Wasem generalized residue theorem for Cauchy principal value integrals through poles and applies it to the valence formula for modular forms on the modular group.

informal.generalizedResidueTheorem: Proves the Hungerbühler-Wasem generalized residue theorem for piecewise-C1 curves through poles.
informal.generalizedResidueTheorem_simplePoles: Specializes the generalized residue theorem to the simple-pole case.
informal.valence_formula_textbook_orbit_finsum: Proves the valence formula for modular forms on the modular group.
